Guideline: Use zod (or valibot) at IO boundaries
Do: z.object({...}).parse(req.body) at the entry of every handler
Don't: Trust 'as User' casts on raw input
Code Good: const Body = z.object({ email: z.string().email() }); Body.parse(req.body)

Guideline: Set timeouts and AbortController on all outbound calls
Do: new AbortController() with setTimeout for cancellation
Code Good: const ctrl = new AbortController(); setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 2000); fetch(url, { signal: ctrl.signal })
